about: Public reference sources Coordn8 keeps a dated local copy of. Fetched by scripts/refs/refresh.py into <user_home>/refs/<id>.<format> with an index.json of fetch dates; checked at run time by scripts/refs/check.py, which lists anything older than max_age_days so the agent re-fetches it before relying on it and stamps 'as of <date>' on what it used. Only public pages are listed; nothing is ever sent to a hosted AI service; a failed or offline refresh keeps the last good copy.
